Signal Clone — New API endpoint
Last update: May 14, 2026
OKX is adding API support for the Signal Clone (Order Sharing) feature. API traders can now generate a universal sharing link programmatically by passing an order ID. The link encodes the order parameters (instrument, side, leverage, price, TP/SL, etc.) server-side. Recipients who open the link will have those parameters prefilled in the OKX App trading panel.
This feature is scoped to USDT-margined perpetual contracts. Signal Clone must be enabled for the account.
Create signal link
Create signal link
A new endpoint POST /api/v5/copytrade/create-sgl-link is added. Pass orderId and instId in the request body. The order must belong to the requesting account. Only USDT-margined perpetual contracts ( instId ending in -USDT-SWAP ) are supported. Other instrument types will return an error. Returns a shortLink — a universal OKX App link that can be shared with others to prefill the trading panel with the order parameters. Rate limit: 10 requests per second per user.
Request example
POST /api/v5/copytrade/create-sgl-link
body { "orderId" : "3556007031710728192" , "instId" : "ADA-USDT-SWAP" }
Request parameters
Parameter Type Required Description orderId String Yes Order ID. Must belong to the requesting account. instId String Yes Instrument ID, e.g. BTC-USDT-SWAP . Only USDT-margined perpetuals are supported.
Response example
{ "code" : "0" , "data" : [ { "shortLink" : "https://www.okx.com/ul/1xJ7nV" } ], "msg" : "" }
Response parameters
Parameter Type Description shortLink String Universal sharing link. Recipients can open this link in the OKX App to have the order parameters prefilled in the trading panel.

WebSocket Orders Channel: Push Behavior Adjustment
Last update: Aug 10, 2026
To help clients more clearly determine the final status of post-only new orders (including mmp_and_post_only ) and rpi new orders — and to avoid scenarios where an order is still canceled after the client has already received a state: live event — OKX will adjust the state: live event behavior for post-only and rpi orders in the Order channel .
Impact details
The state: live event will be pushed only after the order has successfully entered the order book, instead of immediately upon order receipt (a delay of approximately 1 ms). In failed order placement scenarios (price crosses the BBO and is canceled), the state: live update will be removed entirely — only a state: canceled update will be pushed.
Scenario Before After post-only order placement failure (price crosses the BBO and is canceled) state: live → state: canceled Only state: canceled (no state: live ) post-only order placed successfully state: live pushed immediately state: live (delayed ~1 ms) post-only order placed successfully, then filled by one taker order state: live → state: filled state: live (delayed ~1 ms) → state: filled post-only order placed successfully, then filled by multiple partial fills state: live → state: partially_filled → state: filled state: live (delayed ~1 ms) → state: partially_filled → state: filled post-only order with reduceOnly: true , size modified state: live → state: live ( amendSource: 4 , amendResult: 0 ) state: live ( amendSource: 4 , amendResult: 0 ) → state: live rpi order, rpiPxRound: false , order placement failure (canceled due to not meeting the price spacing rule) N/A Only state: canceled (no state: live ) rpi order, rpiPxRound: true , and price is modified N/A state: live ( amendSource: 6 , amendResult: 0 ) → state: live
Effective date
For rpi orders (including elp orders, which will be deprecated): already live — demo trading — July 23, 2026 ; production — July 28, 2026 . For post_only and mmp_and_post_only orders: demo trading — August 10, 2026 (live) ; production — August 20, 2026 .
Scope of impact
The order types affected are: post_only , mmp_and_post_only , and rpi (Retail Price Improvement).
Other order types — such as limit (regular limit orders), market (market orders), ioc , and fok — will have their push behavior remain unchanged.
